content.text: This text is an alphabetical medical index, primarily covering digestive, hepatic, pancreatic, rectal, rheumatic, infectious, and pediatric diseases. It provides page references for symptoms, causes, pathology, diagnosis, prognosis, treatment, complications, and therapeutic agents. Major sections include liver diseases (jaundice, cirrhosis, abscess, cancer, amyloid and fatty degeneration), pancreatic disorders, peritonitis, intestinal obstruction and inflammation, gastric diseases and ulcers, esophageal and pharyngeal conditions, rectal and anal diseases, rheumatism, scrofula, scurvy, hereditary syphilis, rachitis, and parasitic infections. Numerous historical treatments are listed, including mercury, iodides, opium, quinine, iron, purgatives, dietary measures, enemata, irrigation, puncture, laparotomy, and other surgical procedures.
